asset.description: 七座城市的連線圖，每條連線旁標示佈線成本數字

content_en.prompt: An internet service provider wants to set up a network connecting seven cities so that every city can send/receive messages from any other city. The company must pay to set up each link; costs are shown on the connecting lines.
content_en.question: What links should be set up so that the total cost is minimal?
content_en.explanation: The minimum total cost achievable while connecting all seven cities is 16, using the cheapest set of links that still forms a connected network (a minimum spanning tree).
content_en.ct_explanation: This is finding a minimum spanning tree: given a graph where cities are vertices and possible links are edges (with costs/weights), find the subset of edges forming a tree connecting every vertex with the least total cost. Prim's algorithm is a well-known greedy algorithm for this, developed in 1930 by Vojtěch Jarník and rediscovered by Robert C. Prim (1957) and Edsger Dijkstra (1959) — hence also called the Prim-Jarník or DJP algorithm. It works by growing the tree one edge at a time, always adding the cheapest edge connecting the tree to a new vertex.

content_zh.prompt: 一間網路服務公司想建置一個網路，把七座城市連接起來，讓每座城市都能互相收發訊息。公司必須付費才能在城市之間佈線，每條連線的成本都標示在線段旁。
content_zh.question: 應該架設哪些連線，才能讓總成本最低？
content_zh.explanation: 能連接全部七座城市的最低總成本是16——選擇一組成本最低、又能讓所有城市保持連通的連線組合（也就是最小生成樹）。
content_zh.ct_skills: 演算法思維（Algorithmic Thinking）、抽象化（Abstraction）
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這其實是在找「最小生成樹」：把城市當作圖裡的頂點、可能的連線當作邊（每條邊都有成本/權重），要找出一組邊構成一棵樹，連接所有頂點，且總成本最低。實現這個目標的知名演算法叫做Prim演算法，它是一種貪婪演算法，1930年由捷克數學家Vojtěch Jarník提出，後來又分別被Robert C. Prim(1957)和Edsger Dijkstra(1959)重新發現，所以也被稱為Prim-Jarník演算法或DJP演算法。它的做法是每次只新增一條「連接樹與樹外某個頂點、且成本最低」的邊，逐步把整棵樹長出來。
